data.name: Stevie
data.long_meaning: Given name Stevie is derived from the name Stewart which is composed of two Old English words ‘stig’ and ‘weard’ meaning ‘crown’ and ‘guardian’ or ‘steward’ respectively. The name Stevie is used as a diminutive or a nickname for the name Stewart and can be used for both boys and girls.
data.spiritual_meaning: Stevie is a name that carries a deep spiritual meaning, it is a reminder to be a crown bearer, a guardian, and a steward of your life. It is a name that symbolizes leadership, responsibility, and protection. It is also a name that resonates with the energy of music, creativity, and rebellion.
data.numerology_meaning: The name Stevie is governed by the number 3 (3+20=23, 2+3=5). Number 3 is a number of creativity, self-expression, and communication. It is a number that represents growth and expansion. People with the name Stevie are often natural communicators, artists, and musicians. They have a strong desire to express themselves and share their ideas with the world.

in_hebrew.name: סטיבי
in_hebrew.meaning: נגזר משמו של סטפנוס, כלומר כתר או זר
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם סטיבי הוא צורה מקוצרת של השם סטפנוס, שמקורו ביוונית ומשמעותו כתר או זר. השם סטפנוס מוזכר בברית החדשה כראשון המרטירים הנוצרים, סטפנוס הקדוש. השם הוא סמלי לנצחון והצלחה, והוא נושא משמעות רבה בנצרות.

in_greek.name: Στίβι
in_greek.meaning: Παράγωγο του Στεφανός, που σημαίνει στεφάνι ή κορόι
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Στίβι είναι μια σύντομη μορφή του ονόματος Στεφανός, το οποίο προέρχεται από την ελληνική γλώσσα και σημαίνει στεφάνι ή κορόι. Ο Στεφανός αναφέρεται στην Καινή Διαθήκη ως ο πρώτος μάρτυρας των Χριστιανών, ο Άγιος Στεφανός. Το όνομα είναι συμβολικό για τη νίκη και την επιτυχία, και έχει μεγάλη σημασία στο Χριστιανισμό.

One of the most celebrated figures bearing the moniker was the legendary rock musician Stevie Ray Vaughan. His electrifying guitar work helped to revive the blues and brought new life to the guitar genre. Another gifted individual was Stevie Wonder, a blind musician who soared to the heights of Motown with his critical and commercial successes. Stevie Nicks, a Grammy Award-winning singer-songwriter and a member of the iconic band Fleetwood Mac, has also contributed to the cultural legacy of the name with her enchanting voice and spellbinding stage presence.
